scope: Supplied patch, hardened reusable tools, additional diagnostics, exporter, report generator and final derived evidence

axes.correctness: Strict length/coordinate/finite-box checks; paired bootstrap and negative-frame accounting verified; aggregate deltas reconstructed from replacements.
axes.readability: Protocol separates primary, exploratory, label-assisted and post-registration diagnostics; candidate flags are not claimed as acquisition truth.
axes.architecture: Isolated v7 with read-only old inputs; shared scoring formulas retained; no training controller or model changes.
axes.security: Portable ASCII sources/logs/metadata and decompressed predictions scanned; original labels/media excluded; original external session URL redacted.
axes.performance: Fixed-size lag search and CPU-only one-shot queue; completed without repeated jobs or background scheduler.

findings_resolved: Confusing prediction agreement with annotation accuracy
Overclaiming timing-fit flags as confirmed desynchronization
remaining_limits: Single detector seed and validation-only study
Encoded PTS are not capture clocks
No new timing calibration, relabeling or training
